faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq1.q: Is BuildXact Saudi priced in Saudi Riyal?
faq1.a: Yes. Every plan, invoice, and the Quick Estimate calculator are priced and displayed in SAR, with VAT shown separately.
faq2.a: The entire platform — marketing site, user dashboard, and admin panel — is fully bilingual with a complete right-to-left Arabic layout.
faq3.q: Can I try it before paying?
faq3.a: Every plan includes a free trial with no credit card required. Your account administrator can adjust the trial length at any time.
faq4.q: Can I export estimates and invoices as PDF?
faq4.a: Yes, in English or Arabic, with a choice of professional PDF templates.
faq5.q: What is the Digital Takeoff tool?
faq5.a: Upload a plan or drawing, calibrate its scale, then click or trace directly on the image to measure lengths, areas, and item counts — and send the results straight into an estimate.

about.title: Built in the Kingdom, for the Kingdom's builders
about.lead: BuildXact Saudi brings modern job costing and construction management software to contractors, developers, and subcontractors across Saudi Arabia. We help teams move away from scattered spreadsheets and WhatsApp threads into one connected system for estimating, budgeting, scheduling, and invoicing — in Arabic and English, priced in Saudi Riyal, and built to be compliant with ZATCA from day one.

about.story.title: Why we built this
about.story.p1: Most construction management software sold in Saudi Arabia was designed somewhere else first — priced in a foreign currency, translated as an afterthought, and blind to how invoicing actually works here. Contractors ended up bolting on spreadsheets for VAT, a separate tool for quotes, and a WhatsApp group for everything in between.
about.story.p2: We started BuildXact Saudi to close that gap: one system, built around the Saudi contractor's actual workflow, from a same-day Quick Estimate for a walk-in client to a fully ZATCA-compliant tax invoice for a multi-phase development — with Arabic and English working equally well throughout, not as an afterthought.
about.mission.title: Our mission
about.mission.desc: Give every Saudi contractor — from a two-person renovation crew to a multi-branch developer — the tools to price accurately, stay compliant, and get paid on time.
about.vision.title: Our vision
about.vision.desc: A Saudi construction industry where every quote is accurate, every invoice is compliant, and every contractor spends less time on paperwork and more time building.
about.values.title: The principles behind the product
about.value1.title: Local-first
about.value1.desc: SAR pricing, ZATCA-ready invoices, and full Arabic/RTL support — built for how business is actually done here, not translated after the fact.
about.value2.title: Compliance by design
about.value2.desc: ZATCA Phase 1 and Phase 2 e-invoicing are built into the core product, not sold as a bolt-on add-on you have to configure yourself.
about.value3.title: Built for the trade
about.value3.desc: Estimating, takeoff, scheduling, and job costing designed around how contractors actually work on site — not a generic project management tool relabeled for construction.
about.value4.title: Support that shows up
about.value4.desc: A team based in the Kingdom, ready to help with onboarding, data migration, and training for your office and site crews.
about.value5.title: Your data, your control
about.value5.desc: Every company's data is fully isolated and exportable — you are never locked into a system you cannot leave.
about.value6.title: Always improving
about.value6.desc: We ship new features based directly on what contractors tell us they need next — not a fixed roadmap decided in isolation.

support.title: Help Center
support.lead: Already a customer? Open a support ticket from your company panel or client portal and we'll respond quickly.
support.card1.title: Open a ticket
support.card1.desc: Company owners and staff open a ticket right from their panel, with image/file attachments if needed.
support.card2.title: Your clients are covered too
support.card2.desc: Your own clients can raise a request from their client portal — it comes straight to you to resolve.
support.card3.title: Priority support
support.card3.desc: Professional and Enterprise plans get faster response times on every ticket.
support.faq1.q: How do I open a support ticket?
support.faq1.a: Log in to your panel, choose "Support" in the sidebar, and submit a new request with a description and any attachments.
support.faq2.q: What's the difference between the free trial and a subscription?
support.faq2.a: Every new account starts with a full-featured free trial. When it ends, subscribe from the Billing page inside your panel.
support.faq3.a: Yes — every plan includes ZATCA Phase 1 QR codes, and Professional/Enterprise include full Phase 2 (Fatoora) integration.
support.faq4.q: What if I forgot my password?
support.faq4.a: Use "Forgot password" on the login page to reset it via email.
security.title: Your data, protected and compliant
security.lead: :site is built for Saudi contractors — from ZATCA compliance to keeping your project and client data safe.
security.card1.title: ZATCA-compliant e-invoicing
security.card1.desc: Phase 1 QR codes on every invoice, and full Phase 2 (reporting/integration) e-invoicing on Professional and Enterprise plans.
security.card2.title: Company-level data isolation
security.card2.desc: Every company operates in a fully isolated data space — no other company can ever see your projects, clients, or invoices.
security.card3.title: Role-based access control
security.card3.desc: Decide exactly who on your team can see invoices, edit estimates, or only view — down to the individual role.
security.card4.title: Encrypted passwords
security.card4.desc: Every password is hashed with industry-standard algorithms — nobody on our team can ever see it in plain text.
security.card5.title: Secure share links
security.card5.desc: Estimate-signing and invoice-payment links use long, unguessable random tokens — not sequential IDs.
security.card6.title: You always own your data
security.card6.desc: Export your company data any time. We never sell or share your data with third parties for marketing.
